episodeTitle: North and south Indian temples tell you apart by the tower

prompt.en: Sort each temple or feature into its style.
prompt.hi: हर मंदिर या विशेषता को उसकी शैली में रखिए।

text.en: A curved tower (shikhara) topped by a ribbed stone disc (amalaka)
text.hi: घुमावदार शिखर, ऊपर धारीदार पत्थर की चकरी (आमलक)

text.en: Tall gateways (gopurams) in a walled compound

takeaway.en: Look at the tower first: a curved shikhara means Nagara, a stepped vimana means Dravida. Odisha's temples are a regional form of Nagara.
takeaway.hi: पहले शिखर देखिए: घुमावदार शिखर हो तो नागर, सीढ़ीदार विमान हो तो द्रविड़। ओडिशा के मंदिर नागर शैली का क्षेत्रीय रूप हैं।

sources: NCERT Class 11, An Introduction to Indian Art (Part I), ch. 6 'Temple Architecture and Sculpture'

review.note: Written by Claude from the listed sources, 14 Nov 2026. Hindi by Claude. Not yet checked by a subject or Hindi editor.
